name: unipaper-khu-local
description: Open one paper with KHU access while credentials remain inside this computer.

interface.shortDescription: Use KHU access without exposing credentials
interface.longDescription: Opens a user-selected paper in an isolated local browser helper on macOS, Windows, or Linux. The helper reuses its local session or reads KHU credentials from the operating-system vault without returning them to MCP or the model.
defaultPrompt: 경희대 서울캠퍼스 계정으로 이 논문을 로컬에서 열어줘.
